messages:
olivia: Quick sync  We're doing a runtime-led cutover in 45m. Order: Runtime (canary) -> API (minor) -> Router (traffic-shift) -> Console. Change window 45m. Small canaries only. Need pin and rollback agreement.
ryan: ack runtime. I'll enable extra logging and watch kv hitrate and p99.
tom: API team ack. We'll keep schema compatibility mode on and hold new endpoints behind feature flag.
sara: Console: will pin to api:4.4.x for the window and freeze console schema rollouts.
olivia: pin snippet and rollback gates below. Keep convo here for go/no-go.
olivia: ```pins:
  runtime: "2.8.1-q"
  api: "4.4.0-beta"
  router: "edge-2026-03-21b"
  console: "pin-2026-03-21"
rollback-gates:
  - error-rate increase > 250% over baseline for 2m
  - p99 latency > 3s for 2m
  - sustained cache miss > 10% for 4m```
ryan: runtime detail: quant fallback enabled. If cache-miss >10% I'll flip runtime back to 2.8.0 within the 45m window.
tom: router note: we'll start with 3% traffic, then 20% at +12m, then 60% at +30m if green. We have a script to revert within 60s.
sara: console will enable read-only fallback if rpc errors spike. Also locking release-notes PR until post-cutover. Link: https://git.internal/release-notes/2026-03-21
ci-bot: preflight summary: tests: pass, infra quotas: ok, monitor dashboards exist. Use `/deploy run-cutover 6865432100` to start.
olivia: timeline: T-20m final check. T=0 runtime 3% canary. T+10m api canary. T+12m router 20% bump. T+30m ramp to 60% if stable. T+40m final check and full rollout.
ryan: I'll stream runtime logs to #runtime-triage and mark any rollback request with `ROLLBACK-RUNTIME` here.
tom: Router will annotate requests with header X-cutover:id so we can trace.
sara: I'll hold console clients with a pinned header check to avoid mixing versions.
olivia: please react with :white_check_mark: if you will be reachable.
ryan: :white_check_mark:
tom: :white_check_mark:
sara: :white_check_mark:
deploy-bot: scheduled job created by olivia at 6865433000. Canary buckets reserved: small-a(3%), small-b(20%).
ci-bot: note: change window 45m recorded and escalation path set to oncall@pagerduty.
olivia: final: ensure release_notes PR stays blocked until T+50m. If anyone triggers rollback, call it in this thread and runbook step number 2 is automated revert.
ryan: copying rollback play into runbook and adding a one-liner: `ssh ops@router && ./flip_traffic.sh revert`
olivia: I'll post go/no-go at 6865432988 (T-20).
